basic_details.job_title: Gujarat Vidyapith Assistant Professor (Commerce) Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree with 55% marks in a concerned/relevant/allied subject plus NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations, OR a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked among the top 500 (QS/THE/ARWU). Knowledge of Gujarati/Hindi essential.
qualification.details: Qualification: A. (i) A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university; A. (ii) Cleared NET conducted by UGC or CSIR, or a similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET, or awarded a Ph.D. per UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016; OR B. Ph.D. from a foreign university/institution ranked among top 500 in QS, THE or ARWU World University Ranking (at any time) | Other conditions: | Knowledge of Gujarati/Hindi is essential, as the medium of instruction at all levels is generally Gujarati Other conditions as per UGC Regulations, 2018, amended from time to time

how_to_apply: Report on 17.11.2026 at 10.00 AM at Central Office, Gujarat Vidyapith, Near Income Tax, Ahmedabad - 380009.
The application form is printed on pages 4 and 5 of the notice.
important_instructions: 5% relaxation at Bachelor's and Master's level for SC/ST/OBC (Non-creamy Layer)/Differently-abled candidates, based only on qualifying marks without grace marks 5% relaxation (55% to 50%) for Ph.D. holders who obtained their Master's Degree prior to 19 September, 1991 Gujarat Vidyapith reserves the right not to fill up any of the vacancies and may increase or decrease the number of posts Gujarat Vidyapith reserves the right to invite applications, interview/seminar and appoint qualified and deserving candidates

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Gujarat Vidyapith Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Gujarat Vidyapith Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview for Gujarat Vidyapith Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Central Office, Gujarat Vidyapith, Near Income Tax, Ahmedabad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.50,000 fixed per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree with 55% marks in a concerned/relevant/allied subject plus NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations, OR a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked among the top 500 (QS/THE/ARWU). Knowledge of Gujarati/Hindi essential.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Gujarati/Hindi is essential, as the medium of instruction at all levels is generally Gujarati. Other conditions as per UGC Regulations, 2018, amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Canvassing in any form on behalf of or by any candidate will disqualify him/her. A candidate furnishing incorrect or false information shall stand disqualified.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Short-listing for interview on the basis of the Academic score as specified in Appendix II (Table 3A) for Universities and Appendix II (Table 3B) for Colleges. Selection based only on performance in the interview. Academic score as per Appendix II (Table 3A) for Universities and Appendix II (Table 3B) for Colleges used only for short-listing for interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary and on contractual basis for 11 months or completion of semester (whichever is earlier).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ahmedabad.
